original_bug_description: Stack-use-after-return in PHP's unserialization code (php_var_unserialize_internal / process_nested_data in ext/standard/var_unserializer.re). During deserialization of crafted input, zval_get_type ends up reading a zval that refers to stack memory which has gone out of scope, causing reads of invalid stack memory and leading to crashes or other undefined behavior during unserialize.
normalized_bug_description: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=4532420363812864: php-src has a reported memory-safety bug. Stack-use-after-return in PHP's unserialization code (php_var_unserialize_internal / process_nested_data in ext/standard/var_unserializer.re). During deserialization of crafted input, zval_get_type ends up reading a zval that refers to stack memory which has gone out of scope, causing reads of invalid stack memory and leading to crashes or other undefined behavior during unserialize.
